$note: Every design file in this handoff. kind=pane: the right pane alone, 460 x 900, to build to. kind=sheet: parts and states on one page.

screens.shows: At rest, with the caret in a value. The frontmatter is the file’s own text in a quiet block; each line has a type icon, and dates, links and checkboxes get a small control.
Tab from the last value made a new line. Names used elsewhere are offered as you type, each with its type.
A text value offers what other documents put under the same name.
Click a line’s icon to change its type. The value is rewritten to match when it can be.
The calendar button, or the completion key, opens the Mac’s own date picker. The file keeps the ISO date.
Typing a new item in a list offers items other documents use.
A link value offers files in the project by title or path, and writes a quoted Markdown link.
While the text doesn’t parse, the offending line is outlined, a line under the block says why, and nothing is rewritten or lost.
A line Claude changed carries the same mark as Claude’s additions in the document, until your next edit.
Folded to its heading. The document starts straight under it.
A task note. Its sessions list is a list of links, one per line; away from the caret each shows as its title with a button that opens the session.
Typing --- on the first line of a document, or choosing Add Properties, starts the block with the most-used names on offer.
The parts on one sheet: a line and its states, the types and how each is written in the file, the controls, lists over several lines, and the keys.
